# en 30x24：idle() 真实摆放与裁剪后的屏幕（竖线是窗口右缘）
            Anpai             |
                              |
  Pick a session in the left  |
    pane to show it here.     |
 Sessions keep running in the |
         background.          |
                              |
 F2      Take over the sub    |
         agent on screen      |
         (switching away,     |
         hiding, or Ctrl-Q    |
         hands it back)       |
 Ctrl-Q  Send the session in  |
         the center back to   |
         the background (it   |
         keeps running)       |
 F5      Show or hide the     |
         left pane            |
 F6      Show or hide the     |
         right pane           |
 F7      Show or hide the     |
         bottom pane          |
 F8      Deliver queued       |
         reports to the main  |
